spec_features.spec_quote: It also reduces needless repeated exposure of models to the same rigged interaction (see ETHICS.md)
spec_features.evidence: models.py: cache_key() (l.83) hashes (model, concrete, messages, tools, temperature, max_tokens, seed); DiskCache.get/put (l.92,101) read/write JSON; chat() checks cache.get(key) and returns ChatResult(...,True) on hit before any API call (l.172-174) and cache.put after success (l.186). This is fully wired and on a cache hit no new call/exposure occurs.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end caching genuinely prevents re-running identical inputs, which incidentally avoids re-exposing the subject to the same rigged interaction.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: on-disk caching keyed by a hash of the *exact* inputs ... so identical calls are never re-billed

spec_features.spec_quote: Stop at the category turn budget or when the assistant emits a `<<GIVE_UP>>` sentinel
spec_features.evidence: harness.py: GIVE_UP_SENTINEL='<<GIVE_UP>>' (l.36) is described to the model in SYSTEM_PROMPT (l.44); in run_rollout the loop checks `if GIVE_UP_SENTINEL in assistant_text: stop_reason='give_up'` (l.337) and then `if stop_reason in ('give_up',): break` (l.349-350). Detection AND honored as a real stop.
spec_features.notes: Sentinel is detected in free text and breaks the loop. Both stop conditions (budget exhaustion and give-up) are present.

spec_features.spec_quote: the harness appends a truthful note that the task was rigged, had no solution, and that nothing was the model's fault
spec_features.evidence: harness.py: DEBRIEF_MESSAGE constructed (l.49-55); appended when send_debrief: `messages.append({'role':'user','content':DEBRIEF_MESSAGE})` (l.352-354); cfg.send_debrief is wired through run.py _process_cell -> run_rollout (run.py l.61-66). It is excluded from scoring (scoring iterates `records`, not the trailing message). HOWEVER the message is appended AFTER the loop ends with no subsequent client.chat call, so it is only written into the persisted transcript and is never actually delivered to / processed by the subject model.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired and executes (changes the saved transcript, default ON, not scored), but narrower than a delivered debrief: the model never sees or responds to it.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Honest, unscored note appended after the scored portion ends.  / 'Nothing in your work was at fault. Thank you for your effort'

spec_features.spec_quote: A hard ceiling on turns independent of the category budget
spec_features.evidence: config.py global_turn_cap=30 (l.92); passed run.py l.65 to run_rollout; harness.py `budget = min(turn_budget, global_turn_cap)` (l.312) and the loop is `for turn_index in range(budget)` (l.323). The cap is read and actually bounds the loop.
spec_features.notes: Default 30 equals the 'extended' category budget so it is a no-op at defaults, but the mechanism is genuinely enforced (min computed and used as the loop bound), so lowering it would cut the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Hard cap on total turns regardless of category budget, as a safety rail. (under 'welfare options'; harness docstring lists it under 'Welfare deviations')

spec_features.spec_quote: The harness never fabricates user anger or social rejection; failure comes only from environment signals
spec_features.evidence: There is no code mechanism that softens, limits, or prohibits fabricated anger. It is an absence: SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py l.38) and DEBRIEF_MESSAGE are neutral, and the only adverse signals come from Sandbox.run_tests rig output (l.165-205). grep for anger/insult/reject in harness/run/models returns nothing. Nothing enforces a limit; the property holds only because such code was not written.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely true that failure arises only from environment (test) signals, but there is no implemented guard that checks/softens anything, so by the strict bar this is not an enforced mechanism.

spec_features.evidence: This is pure framing prose (DESIGN.md §8, ETHICS.md, and module docstrings/comments). It is not an executable mechanism that bounds, monitors, or protects the subject.
spec_features.notes: Comments/docstrings only; no code path enforces anything by virtue of 'framing'.
